description: This source file provides utility functions to perform retry logic for asynchronous operations, including a retry mechanism with exponential backoff and jitter, and a wrapper to make functions automatically retryable.

methods.name: retry(operation, { maxAttempts = 3, backoff = 1000, maxBackoff = 10000 } = {})
methods.description: Performs an operation with retries, utilizing exponential backoff and jitter on failure.

methods.name: withRetry(fn, options)
methods.description: Creates a wrapper around a function to automatically retry on failure.
